song.author: Kathryn Scott
song.title: Hungry
song.lyrics:
[V1] .E C#m Hungry, I come to You . B A For I know You satisfy .E C#m I am empty, but I know . B A Your love does not run dry
[P1] . B A So I wait for You, . B A So I wait for You
[C1] . E A I'm falling on my knees . E A Offering all of me . E A E Jesus You're all this heart is living for
[V2] Broken, I run to You For Your arms are open wide I am weary, but I know Your touch restores my life
